title: Bumper Ducks
tagline: Bonk, bounce and squeak! Up to 4 rubber ducks in bumper boats grab bubbles and stars.
howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to paddle your duck. Tap 💨 (or Space) to dash and BONK! Bubbles are worth 1, stars 3. 🎁 boxes make you giant, super fast or bouncy. Bonk a friend out of the water for a splash bonus. Nobody is ever out!
